sections.text:
-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the value of the Fire element weakening effect on monsters is increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Applies Beguilement for 30 seconds.
-Removes Slumber from all allies.
-Target: All allies including the Rear Guard. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Dawn for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases the Ability Power of Cleric/Morpher's physical/magic Abilities by 20 when equipped in the Main Slot.
